context.notes: Wall formwork and rebar in progress.

result.summary: Construction site with multiple workers engaged in wall formwork and rebar installation, working around vertical rebar projections and bamboo scaffolding.

ppe.notes: At least four workers are visible. Some workers are wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests, but at least one worker appears to be missing high-vis gear or a hard hat.

findings.description: Unprotected vertical rebar dowels protruding upwards throughout the work area, posing impalement hazards.
findings.location_in_image: Throughout the center and foreground around concrete wall forms
findings.corrective_action: Install mushroom caps or trough guards on all vertical rebar ends immediately.

findings.description: Scattered timber formwork pieces and debris near edges and walkways.
findings.location_in_image: Foreground lower right and bottom center
findings.corrective_action: Clear scrap timber and organize materials to maintain safe walkways and prevent trip hazards.

immediate_actions: Install rebar caps on all exposed vertical rebar ends to eliminate impalement risks.
Verify 100% compliance with hard hat and high-visibility vest requirements for all personnel on deck.
Clear housekeeping debris and scrap wood from walkways.
result.image_quality_note: Clear, well-lit photograph showing workers and site conditions in moderate detail.
